plain: Entered by an army to attack; also broken into or violated

webster.text: Entered by an army with a hostile design; attacked; assaulted; infringed; violated.

example.quote: The restriction includes only offensive hostility, as they are at liberty to engage in war when invaded, or in imminent danger.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 16, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
